label: Documentary
description: Credible, evidence-led storytelling with interview authenticity and contextual visuals.
intent: Tell a truthful, coherent story; never sacrifice factual meaning for retention.
avoid: cutting an interview to reverse its meaning
fake documentary inserts presented as real
opening: Present the question, tension or compelling observed moment without deceptive framing.
editing: Build a paper edit; support claims with verifiable footage, dates and labels; preserve pauses when they are meaningful.
typography: Legible lower thirds and source labels, consistent with the piece; no unnecessary word-by-word text.
sound: Natural room tone bridges and careful dialogue treatment; preserve authenticity.
critique: Does the sequence preserve context and distinguish archive, recreation, opinion and fact?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
